title: App link issues and owner comments
summary: Feedback in this topic mixes praise for vehicle appearance and suspension with complaints about unreliable app linking and a dangerous issue, while several fragments are too vague or informational to determine sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the car's looks and the feel of the suspension.

negative.summary: Negative reviews report a slow, unreliable remote app link and mention a letter describing an issue as dangerous.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention a possible July update, sending a YouTube link, and a brief note that something should link up on its own without enough context for sentiment.

limitations: This topic appears to combine unrelated subjects, including design and suspension praise, app connectivity problems, a safety-related letter, and informational link references.
Several fragments are very short or lack enough context to identify the exact issue or sentiment with confidence.
The sample is small and sentiment-stratified, so it should not be treated as representative of all G60 feedback.
